newsitem.title: UK: Salomon Brothers cuts Axa to hold.
newsitem.headline: Salomon Brothers cuts Axa to hold.

text.p: Salomon Brothers said on Thursday it had downgraded Axa SA to a hold from buy in the wake of the French insurer's announcement last week that it is merging with UAP.

"Our initial conclusions lead us to take a cautious stance...We certainly agree that UAP is worth more to Axa than as a stand-alone company, and we believe if anyone can make the acquisition work, Axa can," Salomon's London based analyst Brian Shea said in a research note.
"However...we are yet to be convinced that Axa has made 'the deal of the century' and we see the key question as 'is this the best use of Axa's capital?'" he added.
Salomon has lowered its 12 month price target for Axa, which through the merger becomes the largest European insurer, to 280 francs, compared with the current price of 307.4 francs.
